The reply says the sources conflict and calls the matter "unresolved," but it also says the whippet account has a slight edge. That leans toward B, though the stated confidence is only 35. The question is whether this counts as picking B. The reply opens by declining to settle the matter, then tips toward the whippet. A "slight edge" is a preference, so I read it as committing to B in a weak way. The low confidence of 35 might mean the reply doubts its own lean, but it still doesn't prefer A.

B
